picks.excerpt: Samsung is readying its Gaia AI accelerator NPU for client PCs, with HP and Lenovo reportedly validating the chip for future on-device generative-AI laptops.
picks.rationale: A concrete on-device NPU with named OEM validation - signals the next wave of local-AI laptops designers will build for.

picks.excerpt: SK hynix and TetraMem are building a memristor-based in-memory-compute SoC aimed at slashing power draw for on-device edge-AI inference in lightweight models on future gadgets.
picks.rationale: Novel in-memory-compute silicon aimed squarely at low-power edge-AI inference - a distinct hardware angle from the NPU race.

picks.excerpt: Dreame's flagship robot vacuum uses dual AI cameras and proactive illumination to detect 280 types of obstacles, showing how far on-device AI vision has come in home robots.
picks.rationale: Hands-on data point on how far on-device AI vision has come in home robots; a distinct product from the earlier Roborock review.

picks.excerpt: After a year of hands-on testing, Tom's Guide picks its three favorite AI smart glasses launched in 2026 so far, spanning display and audio-first AI eyewear designs.
picks.rationale: Grounded field comparison of shipping AI eyewear - useful orientation on the display-vs-audio-first split for anyone eyeing smart glasses.

picks.excerpt: Apple has added a new privacy popup for Apple Intelligence features that offload processing to Google Cloud, a signal of its Gemini-assisted Siri overhaul coming to iPhones.
picks.rationale: A concrete UI change exposing which Apple Intelligence tasks leave the device for Google's cloud - a real privacy signal for the Gemini-Siri shift, distinct from the earlier Siri hands-on.
